recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Any future change to the financial task code system should be handled through HL7 Terminology/THO stewardship, not by editing core ProcessRequest source.
issue_request: FHIR-17916 asked to add release to the ProcessRequest.action code set; its Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution redirected the change to the code set/value set used for Task.code because ProcessRequest had been deprecated in favor of Task.
initial_application: No FHIR-17916-keyed commit was found. The change appears to have been applied by November 2018 GF #19345 commits that added Financial Management Task examples, a release Task example, and financial task terminology including the release code.
additional_context: ProcessRequest is commented out of active build mappings and annotated to use Task. Task remains active, the Financial Module maps Release to Task code=release, the Task release example uses the THO financialtaskcode system, and THO still publishes release after UTG content moved out of core. The same-family FHIR-18009 audit is already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing ProcessRequest would target retired/out-of-build source, and adding release to the generic TaskCode CodeSystem would be broader than the FM-specific resolution because Task.code is an extensible, workflow-specific binding.

related_jiras.note: Nearly identical Published/Persuasive with Modification request for release on ProcessRequest.action; already represented on the combined branch by 198dd36a.
Same FM issue family removed ProcessRequest/ProcessResponse from active build metadata and documented Task as the replacement path.
